projects.title: DDT Persistence
projects.description: DDT, a persistent and hazardous pesticide, was banned in 1972. There is a pipe off the coast of Southern California that allegedly no longer releases DDT into the ocean. I retrieved water samples from the coast and had them tested for DDT and its by-products. Both DDT and its by-products were present in the samples, and this suggests that some DDT is still leaking from the pipe. I presented and competed in National History Day by showcasing the history of DDT and my findings on a hand painted exhibit.
